# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. Native Windows build and process checks contribute to the pull-request `all checks passed` verdict; Wine runs Windows Node on hosted Linux only in `ci-master.yml`. Keep `ci.yml` pull-request-only. In this Docker repository, `ci-master.yml` and the credentialed `e2e.yml` run only through manual dispatch; self-hosted reference suites require their advertised runner pools. `sandbox.yml` automatically runs Linux unit, deployment, and kernel checks on master pushes, while its macOS job is manual-only. Keep real test failures blocking within every enabled job; see the [Docker CI decision](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-13-docker-ci-scope.md).
